traffic_headline.critical_doctrine_rule: The ~1.65 GB/frame (21.08 GB/s @ 1x) is the SEQUENTIAL-EXECUTION BASELINE, not a physics floor. The all-components one-read floor is ~0.585 GB/frame (7.31 GB/s @ 1x). Never quote 20.7+ GB/s as the bound 'even after' residency or speculation levers.

one_read_physics_floor.label: ALL-COMPONENTS ONE-READ FLOOR (Cache-Resident / Block-Verified)

sequential_execution_baseline.description: Talker read 1x (~443.6 MB) + Microdecoder body read 15x (~1,179.8 MB) + 15 Heads/Embeds (~62.9 MB)
